run:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Reads whitespace-separated tokens from standard input, converts each lowercase letter to its uppercase equivalent, preserves dots, removes the trailing space, and prints the resulting string." run]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Create a Scanner named scan reading from System.in. RESULT scan]
            [COMMAND Initialize b as a 26-element String array containing uppercase letters from A at index 0 through Z at index 25. RESULT b]
            [COMMAND Initialize s as a 26-element String array containing lowercase letters from a at index 0 through z at index 25. RESULT s]
            [COMMAND Create a new empty StringBuffer named max. RESULT max]
            [COMMAND While scan.hasNext() is true, process each token and accumulate transformed output in max. RESULT max]
            [COMMAND Within the outer while loop, read the next token from scan into String min. RESULT min]
            [COMMAND Within the outer while loop, for each character index i from 0 to min.length() - 1 inclusive, extract the one-character substring str at position i. RESULT str]
            [COMMAND Within the for-i loop, if str equals ".", append str to max; otherwise proceed to the lowercase-matching loop. RESULT max]
            [COMMAND Within the else branch of the dot check, for each j from 0 to s.length - 1 inclusive, if str equals s[j], append b[j] to max and continue the innermost j loop; if no match is found, append nothing. RESULT max]
            [COMMAND After the for-i loop finishes for the current token min, append a single space to max. RESULT max]
            [COMMAND After the outer while loop ends, delete the last character of max, which is the trailing space appended after the final token, by calling max.delete(max.length() - 1, max.length()). RESULT max]
            [COMMAND Print the contents of max to System.out. RESULT System.out]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [EXCEPTION_FLOW: No tokens are read from standard input, so the while loop never executes and max remains empty when max.delete(max.length() - 1, max.length()) is called.]
        [LOG "Attempted to delete the last character from an empty StringBuffer; start index is -1 and end index is 0."]
        [THROW StringIndexOutOfBoundsException "Thrown by StringBuffer.delete because the calculated start index is less than 0."]
    [END_EXCEPTION_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
